title: Competitive dataset and reader audit, 2026
method: Expert desk review of first-party public documentation; no participant testing and no proprietary prose collection.

definitions.linked: Direct the reader to the authoritative or useful external record without treating the destination as an RNAWiki endorsement.
definitions.imported: Ingest bounded fields with the upstream database, record identifier, version or update date, retrieval time, rights decision, and raw-artifact digest.
definitions.projected: Compute a deterministic view from imported fields without inventing or rewriting a medical conclusion.
definitions.excluded: Do not store or reproduce the named content or capability.
definitions.deferred: Do not implement until a separately reviewed pipeline and acceptance gate exist.

nonReplacementStatement: RNAWiki organizes source-bound medicine facts, uncertainty, disagreement, and change history. It is not a clinician, regulator, approved label, literature index, chemical registry, trial registry, supplement-testing laboratory, symptom checker, or personalized interaction or dosing tool.

resources.name: Drugs.com
resources.sourceType: Secondary reference aggregation with separately presented user-generated reviews.
resources.provenance: Its editorial policy identifies external data providers; each field still requires provider-level attribution before reuse.
resources.freshness: Editorial maintenance follows source updates; reported errors have a stated review target of 48 hours.
resources.editorialProcess: Professional editorial oversight and external reference providers; community reviews remain separate from reviewed drug information.

access.api: No public content API identified in the official pages reviewed.
access.license: Terms prohibit automated extraction, scraping, mining, and dataset creation.

readerProduct.clarity: High task clarity for common medicine questions.
readerProduct.visuals: Pill images and compact reference tables.
readerProduct.tools: Interaction checker, pill identifier, and drug/condition search.
readerProduct.corrections: Public error-reporting route with a stated response target.
readerProduct.contributions: User ratings and reviews, visibly separate from reviewed reference material.

rnawiki.links: Link a relevant medicine or tool page when it answers the reader's next question.
rnawiki.lessons: Use direct task routes and keep lived experience separate from reviewed evidence.
rnawiki.nonReplacement: RNAWiki does not reproduce Drugs.com content or replace its interaction and identification tools.

resources.name: MedlinePlus
resources.sourceType: Consumer-health portal mixing NLM-authored federal material with separately copyrighted supplier material.
resources.provenance: Pages identify source and review context; ASHP drug monographs are a distinct copyrighted content class.
resources.freshness: Review dates and update practices are public and vary by topic and supplying source.
resources.editorialProcess: NLM selection and review apply to its own topic material; supplier content retains its own editorial ownership.

access.api: MedlinePlus Connect and public web services are available.
access.bulk: XML files are available for eligible content.
access.license: Most federal material is public domain, but ASHP drug information and other marked third-party content are not reusable without permission.

readerProduct.depth: Moderate, with links to deeper sources.
readerProduct.visuals: Accessible illustrations and video where relevant.
readerProduct.tools: Topic search, encyclopedia, dictionary, and developer services.
readerProduct.corrections: Review dates and public feedback routes support revision.

rnawiki.lessons: Use question-led summaries, familiar definitions, and explicit language support.
rnawiki.nonReplacement: RNAWiki does not replace NLM consumer education or ASHP monographs.

imported: eligible NLM-authored public-domain summary fields or XML after content-level rights classification

resources.name: Mayo Clinic
resources.sourceType: Professionally authored and medically reviewed health editorial.
resources.provenance: Sources, authorship, and medical-review context are governed by the health-information policy.
resources.freshness: Rapidly changing topics are reviewed at least every two years, the library is assessed annually, and factual corrections are generally targeted within 30 days.
resources.editorialProcess: Qualified editorial and medical review under Mayo Clinic's published policy.

access.license: Terms reserve site content for limited personal use.

rnawiki.links: Link a relevant Mayo Clinic topic as optional context.
rnawiki.lessons: Use answer-first structure, local definitions, and progressive depth.
rnawiki.nonReplacement: RNAWiki is not Mayo Clinic's clinical editorial service.

resources.name: WebMD
resources.sourceType: Original secondary editorial and licensed reference content, plus separately presented user reviews.
resources.provenance: Original content uses author, medical-review, and source signals; licensed drug content and user reviews remain distinct.
resources.freshness: Review and update dates are shown where applicable; material corrections are targeted within 60 days.
resources.editorialProcess: Published editorial and medical-review policy with separate community content.

readerProduct.clarity: High consumer familiarity and task orientation.
readerProduct.visuals: Extensive video, slideshow, and illustration content.
readerProduct.tools: Symptom checker, interaction checker, and pill identification.
readerProduct.corrections: Public policy with a material-correction target.
readerProduct.contributions: User reviews are accepted and presented separately.

rnawiki.links: Link relevant consumer pages or tools when useful.
rnawiki.lessons: Use familiar question paths and visibly separate editorial evidence from community experience.
rnawiki.nonReplacement: RNAWiki does not replace WebMD's consumer tools or editorial service.

resources.name: FDA
resources.provenance: Authority belongs to the specific programme and dated record, not a generic FDA label.
resources.freshness: Publication and correction are programme-specific; official records and communications are dated.
resources.editorialProcess: Scientific, legal, and regulatory review varies by programme and action type.

access.license: Federal material is generally public domain unless noted; submitted or third-party artifacts require separate rights treatment. FDA recommends linking because pages change.

readerProduct.visuals: Programme-dependent documents, tables, and public communications.
readerProduct.tools: Regulatory searches, recalls, and safety communications.
readerProduct.corrections: Dated official updates and programme contact channels.
readerProduct.contributions: Public comment and adverse-event reporting exist but are not public editing of regulatory conclusions.

rnawiki.links: Link the exact FDA action, communication, or record.
rnawiki.lessons: Show authority, programme, action date, and status without flattening distinct regulatory records.
rnawiki.nonReplacement: RNAWiki is not the regulator and cannot replace an FDA action or approved label.

imported: bounded public regulatory facts and identifiers
deferred: programme-specific sources without a field contract

resources.name: Drugs@FDA
questions: whether and when a product was approved
resources.provenance: Application numbers, product numbers, sponsors, and action dates provide durable bindings.
resources.freshness: The searchable database is updated daily; data files are updated each weekday.
resources.editorialProcess: The records reflect FDA's regulatory application and action process.

access.api: A derived Drugs@FDA endpoint is available through openFDA.
access.license: Government facts are generally public domain; submitted documents need artifact-level rights care.

readerProduct.corrections: Official database updates reflect regulatory corrections and actions.
readerProduct.contributions: Sponsor submissions enter through the regulatory process; no public wiki editing.

rnawiki.links: Link the exact application, product, action, and document.
rnawiki.lessons: Keep application, product, action, and label identities separate.
rnawiki.nonReplacement: RNAWiki cannot declare approval or replace review packages and approved labels.

excluded: submitted content without a rights decision

resources.name: DailyMed
resources.sourceType: Repository of submitted Structured Product Labeling.
resources.provenance: SETID, version, effective time, and labeler bind each record.
resources.freshness: Daily, weekly, monthly, and full releases are available.
resources.editorialProcess: NLM does not review label content before publication; content may differ from FDA-approved labeling and may include unapproved products.

access.bulk: Daily, weekly, monthly, and full SPL downloads.
access.license: Use structured facts and bounded excerpts only after content-level rights checks; do not assume government hosting transfers rights in submitted label text.

readerProduct.visuals: Label and package images where submitted.
readerProduct.tools: Label search, section navigation, API, and downloads.
readerProduct.corrections: Revised SPL submissions and support channels; no open editing.

rnawiki.links: Link the exact SETID and version.
rnawiki.lessons: Expose version and effective time, and keep in-use labeling distinct from FDA approval.
rnawiki.nonReplacement: RNAWiki is not the current label and cannot convert DailyMed presence into approval.

excluded: label and package images without asset-level permission
deferred: new clinical interpretations of label text

resources.name: openFDA
resources.sourceType: Government API transport and harmonization layer.
resources.provenance: Retain the original FDA dataset identity and openFDA harmonization metadata.
resources.freshness: Cadence is endpoint-specific; use download metadata and retrieval timestamps rather than assuming real-time completeness.
resources.editorialProcess: Government data processing and harmonization, not an independent medical editorial review.

access.license: CC0 unless an identified exception applies; terms document privacy, limitation, and attribution considerations.

readerProduct.tools: Query documentation, examples, APIs, and downloads.
readerProduct.corrections: Dataset issue channels; no public record editing.
readerProduct.contributions: Source programmes supply the underlying data.

rnawiki.links: Link the endpoint documentation and underlying FDA record.
rnawiki.lessons: Treat openFDA as transport and make harmonization limits visible.
rnawiki.nonReplacement: RNAWiki must not present openFDA normalization as validation or a second agreeing source.

imported: allowlisted endpoint records and identifiers with raw artifact hashes
excluded: fields without a stable source binding
records covered by an exception that forbids planned reuse

resources.name: NCCIH
resources.sourceType: Federal evidence summaries alongside primary research and programme material.
resources.evidenceRole: mixed, primarily secondary for health fact sheets
resources.provenance: Fact sheets cite research and identify review/update context.
resources.freshness: Page-level review/update context exists; no uniform machine freshness contract was identified for the health library.
resources.editorialProcess: Federal scientific and subject-matter review in NCCIH's publishing context.

access.api: No general public health-content API identified.
access.bulk: No general bulk health-content feed identified.
access.license: Content-level rights and third-party material must be checked before any structured ingestion.

readerProduct.tools: Topic and herb directories plus evidence-literacy modules.
readerProduct.corrections: Page updates and feedback routes; no uniform public correction SLA identified.

rnawiki.links: Link the exact NCCIH topic or herb page.
rnawiki.lessons: Put what the evidence shows, what remains uncertain, and safety boundaries close together.
rnawiki.nonReplacement: RNAWiki does not replace NCCIH evidence summaries, supplement regulation, or individualized advice.

deferred: structured fact-sheet ingestion with claim-scope, citation, version, and rights rules

resources.name: ConsumerLab
resources.sourceType: Independent product testing plus secondary evidence review.
resources.evidenceRole: mixed primary testing and secondary review
resources.provenance: Methods and funding are described publicly; detailed test results remain proprietary.
resources.freshness: Tests and reviews update by programme and product category rather than a public dataset cadence.
resources.editorialProcess: Proprietary laboratory and editorial processes funded through subscriptions and certification programmes.

access.license: Agreement prohibits scraping, text/data mining, and dataset use.

readerProduct.depth: Deep testing and review detail behind subscription access.
readerProduct.visuals: Proprietary comparison tables and certification seals.
readerProduct.tools: Product comparisons, search, and certification/testing programmes.
readerProduct.corrections: Updates occur through the proprietary review and membership process.
readerProduct.contributions: Manufacturers may participate in certification; readers do not edit results.

rnawiki.links: Link the service only as an external product-testing resource.
rnawiki.lessons: Distinguish marketed label claims from independently measured product quality.
rnawiki.nonReplacement: RNAWiki is not a supplement-testing laboratory or subscription product-review service.

linked: service home or relevant public overview

resources.name: Medscape
resources.sourceType: Proprietary professional reference using licensed databases and expert editorial.
resources.provenance: Author, reviewer, reference, and database attribution vary by module.
resources.freshness: Medscape states that drug-reference changes follow new FDA approvals within 48 hours; other modules have their own update dates and review cycles.
resources.editorialProcess: PharmD and medical editorial processes with documented separation of advertising and editorial content.

access.license: Drug and disease reference content is proprietary.

readerProduct.clarity: Efficient for clinicians, not optimized for novice readers.
readerProduct.visuals: Dense tables, images, and professional reference layouts.
readerProduct.tools: Dosing and interaction tools, calculators, search, news, and CME.
readerProduct.corrections: Expert editorial and feedback routes; no public editing.
readerProduct.contributions: Expert authorship and professional submissions, not an open wiki.

rnawiki.links: Link relevant professional material where permitted and useful.
rnawiki.lessons: Keep exact professional detail quickly retrievable without making it the patient default.
rnawiki.nonReplacement: RNAWiki is not clinical decision support or a dosing calculator.

resources.name: RxList
resources.sourceType: WebMD-owned secondary drug reference compiled from FDA and licensed drug-information sources.
resources.provenance: About and editorial pages identify source and reviewer roles.
resources.freshness: The editorial policy describes at least annual medical review.

access.license: Content is proprietary under site terms.

readerProduct.corrections: Healthcare-provider review and feedback routes; no public editing.

rnawiki.links: Link a relevant RxList drug page as optional context.
rnawiki.nonReplacement: RNAWiki does not replace an approved label or licensed drug monograph.

resources.name: NCBI
resources.sourceType: Federal information infrastructure containing multiple independent primary and secondary databases.
resources.provenance: The exact database, accession, version, and contributor are required; NCBI alone is insufficient provenance.
resources.editorialProcess: Curation, submission, review, and correction are database-specific.

access.license: Copyright and reuse vary across databases and records; there is no safe blanket NCBI reuse assumption.

readerProduct.tools: Entrez, BLAST, viewers, APIs, and downloads.
readerProduct.contributions: Deposits, registered submissions, or curation depending on database.

rnawiki.links: Link the exact database record and accession.
rnawiki.lessons: Expose accession, version, contributor, and database rather than a generic institutional badge.
rnawiki.nonReplacement: RNAWiki cannot replace the underlying NCBI database or archive.

imported: allowlisted fields from a named database with a recorded rights decision
projected: database-specific deterministic summaries with exact inputs
excluded: fields without database-specific rights and semantics
deferred: new database integrations without a source contract

resources.name: PubMed
questions: how to find and identify an article
resources.evidenceRole: index, not evidence or critical appraisal
resources.provenance: The journal and publisher own the article context; NLM supplies indexing and links.
resources.editorialProcess: MEDLINE journal selection and NLM indexing improve discovery but do not validate each article's conclusion.

access.bulk: Annual baseline and daily update files.
access.license: Citation metadata can be reused selectively; abstract and full-text copyright varies and must be checked item by item.

readerProduct.clarity: Strong for literature search, especially for professional users.
readerProduct.tools: Advanced search, filters, citation export, APIs, and publisher links.
readerProduct.corrections: Correction and retraction links reflect publisher and database updates.
readerProduct.contributions: Publishers and repositories deposit records; readers do not directly edit citations.

rnawiki.links: Link the PMID and, where appropriate, the publisher record.
rnawiki.lessons: Make search scope and filters visible, and distinguish discovery from evidence judgment.
rnawiki.nonReplacement: RNAWiki is not PubMed, the full article, or a substitute for critical appraisal.

linked: publisher article or lawful full-text location
projected: transparent literature counts and search views

resources.name: PubChem
resources.sourceType: Aggregated chemical repository receiving primary and secondary contributor records and normalizing compound identities.
resources.provenance: Contributor identity and source section must remain attached to each imported field.
resources.freshness: Updates follow contributor releases and PubChem processing; no single scientific review date applies to every property.
resources.editorialProcess: Contributor submissions plus automated standardization and substance-to-compound normalization.

access.license: Licences vary by contributing source; allowlist public/permissive fields and exclude non-commercial or unclear sources.

readerProduct.visuals: 2D and 3D structures, spectra, and linked chemical views.
readerProduct.tools: Name, structure, and similarity search plus APIs and downloads.
readerProduct.contributions: Registered data contributors submit source records.

rnawiki.links: Link the exact CID, SID, AID, or contributor record.
rnawiki.lessons: Keep normalized identity, contributor assertion, property method, and rights provenance distinct.
rnawiki.nonReplacement: RNAWiki is not a chemical authority, contributor database, or laboratory measurement.

imported: allowlisted public/permissive identity, structure, and property fields
projected: calculated descriptors and comparisons with method and version
deferred: new contributor sources pending rights review

resources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
resources.sourceType: Sponsor or investigator-submitted trial registry with limited NLM quality-control review.
resources.evidenceRole: primary submitted registry record, not scientific validation
resources.provenance: NCT ID, responsible party, submission date, posting date, and history are essential.
resources.freshness: Records expose first-posted and last-update dates and history; responsible parties submit updates.
resources.editorialProcess: NLM QC checks record format and apparent validity under public criteria, not scientific merit or truth of the conclusions.

access.bulk: Public record downloads and API pagination.
access.license: Information is generally public domain, subject to the third-party and trademark caveats in the terms.

readerProduct.tools: Search, filters, downloads, API, and record history.
readerProduct.corrections: Responsible-party updates plus NLM QC; no public wiki editing.
readerProduct.contributions: Authorized responsible parties submit and maintain records.

rnawiki.links: Link the exact NCT record and history.
rnawiki.lessons: Show record status, sponsor responsibility, update history, and QC boundary together.
rnawiki.nonReplacement: RNAWiki is not the trial registry, peer review, informed consent, or advice about joining a study.

fieldCrosswalk.field: Canonical medicine name, ingredient, and public identifiers
fieldCrosswalk.rule: Store the exact database and application, SETID, CID, or other record identifier plus retrieval time and artifact digest; never alter a recorded trade name because of a style rule.

fieldCrosswalk.field: Brand/product, route, strength, package, and NDC variants
fieldCrosswalk.rule: Preserve application/product or SPL set/version/package provenance and never imply every DailyMed record is FDA-approved.

fieldCrosswalk.field: Approval status, action date, sponsor, and regulatory history
fieldCrosswalk.rule: Bind every fact to the exact application/action; RNAWiki never grants or infers approval.

fieldCrosswalk.field: Label indications, dosage, contraindications, warnings, and adverse reactions
fieldCrosswalk.rule: Import bounded structured facts or short verification excerpts with label version and section; never merge in-use labeling with approval or automatically rewrite medical copy after drift.

sources: commercial references as outbound links only
fieldCrosswalk.rule: Require an exact source assertion and preserve population, route, measurement, and uncertainty; do not ingest commercial interaction conclusions or produce personalized advice.

fieldCrosswalk.field: Chemical identity, structure, formula, mass, and computed properties
fieldCrosswalk.rule: Store CID/SID, contributor, licence, property method/version, and retrieval time; exclude non-commercial and unclear-source sections.

fieldCrosswalk.field: Trial registration, phase, design, recruitment status, sponsor, eligibility, and sites
fieldCrosswalk.rule: Bind to NCT ID and record history; label status as sponsor-submitted registry data rather than verified clinical truth.
Do not generate efficacy, safety, or programme verdicts automatically; limited NLM QC is not scientific validation.
Keep PMID/accession, publisher or database, dates, and correction/retraction links; indexing is not evidence quality.

fieldCrosswalk.field: Abstracts, articles, books, and source prose
fieldCrosswalk.rule: Exclude unless the exact item has a compatible licence; government hosting or indexing does not transfer third-party rights.
A future import must preserve claim scope, citation, review date, version, and content-specific rights.
No scraping, transcription of test results, rankings, seals, or inferred pass/fail fields.
Learn from product patterns but author RNAWiki copy independently from permitted factual sources; do not closely paraphrase proprietary prose.

fieldCrosswalk.field: Professional dosing, interaction, calculator, and pill-identification tools
fieldCrosswalk.rule: Do not reproduce proprietary logic or imply individualized clinical guidance.

fieldCrosswalk.field: User ratings, reviews, and community experience
fieldCrosswalk.rule: Community experience is not reviewed evidence or source consensus and must not enter candidate memory.

fieldCrosswalk.field: Source agreement, freshness, and review candidates
sources: all imported sources with exact field bindings
fieldCrosswalk.rule: Compare like-for-like assertions only; not_comparable is not disagreement, network failure is not drift, and confirmed persisted drift creates a review item without rewriting medical content.

fieldCrosswalk.field: Images, diagrams, videos, seals, and proprietary visualizations
fieldCrosswalk.rule: Reuse only with asset-level provenance and compatible licence; public availability is not a reuse grant.

linked: All sixteen resources may be linked when the exact destination helps the reader.
Commercial and consumer-editorial links are contextual destinations, not authority badges.
imported: DailyMed and openFDA bounded structured records
Public or permissively licensed PubChem fields with contributor provenance
ClinicalTrials.gov registration, status, design, sponsor, eligibility, site, and history fields
Narrowly permitted PubMed and named-NCBI metadata
Eligible NLM-authored MedlinePlus fields only after content-level rights classification
excluded: proprietary prose, tables, images, and tool logic
records or fields with unresolved reuse rights
deferred: broad literature extraction and automated interpretation

safetyRules: A source drift is a review item and never rewrites medical content automatically.
A temporary network failure is not source drift.
A machine transport or index is not an independent agreeing source.
No imported field may lose its exact source, version or update context, retrieval time, and rights decision.
